thread:
Mara C: Heads up — spotted a weird tariff line on the March invoice for us-east1 GPUs. Looks like a regional surcharge post-commit. Anyone else seeing this? cc @Sam K @Jules :thinking_face:

Sam K: Which line? can you paste the invoice fragment so we can validate charge IDs?

Mara C: Sure, pasted the relevant section below (redacted acc ids):

```
line_id: L-2039445, sku: accelerator.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_T4, region: us-east1, usage_hours: 1024, amount: $12,288.00
line_id: L-2039446, sku: regional-tariff-adjustment, region: us-east1, description: "regional tariff", amount: $1,478.00
```

finance-bot: Provider invoice note posted: https://billing.example.com/cases/98765 — "regional tariff adjustments applied retroactively to accelerated compute SKUs in us-east1." Case created #BILL-998.

Jules: I saw a vendor advisory about an "accelerator regional levy" earlier this month, but I assumed it'd be folded into pricing not as a distinct line item. Weird that it's post-commit.

Sam K: Can we confirm this isn't a double-charge? e.g., both a tariff and an updated base rate. If they rebilled base + tariff we might be overcharged.

Mara C: I pulled the full invoice rows and cross-checked with our commitment offsets. Looks like commitment credits applied only to base sku L-2039445; the tariff line L-2039446 wasn't covered by our reserved capacity credits. snippet: 

```
commitment_credit: C-77a, applied_to: L-2039445, credit_amount: -$9,830.40
commitment_credit: none for L-2039446 (tariff)
```

finance-bot: Filed dispute with provider (case 123456). Requested reversal for March tariff and clarification on whether tariff should be credit-eligible under committed use discounts. Provider ETA 3-5 business days.

Jules: Operational impact: if tariff persists and is non-creditable, our estimated monthly accelerator spend in us-east1 goes up ~12% for current runrate. Will run a quick delta and post numbers.

Sam K: Important for Dedicated planning — if this is region-specific and permanent we should model moving some Dedicated capacity to us-west or europe to preserve unit economics. Also check whether new reservations cover tariff or we need a different commitment type.

Mara C: Agreed. @ops-bot can you add a billing anomaly item to the infra board and tag capacity planning? Also added a temporary alert in Console to flag >8% month-over-month billing delta per region.

ops-bot: Done — Ticket INFRA-4128 created, assigned to Jules. Console alert rule #A-99 enabled for us-east1 billing delta. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: Thanks. Once Jules posts the delta numbers we'll decide whether to adjust regional commitments or open a commercial exception request to the provider. :thumbsup:

Jules: Posting preliminary delta in 30m. If provider confirms reversal we'll backfill numbers accordingly.

Mara C: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open until the provider response.
